attempts.exactPrompt:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Elin Orin: 30-year-old woman, 174 cm (medium), healthy slight, narrow, long-limbed construction with low mass, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: square compact face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; small upturned nose, heavy lower lip; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blonde-gold, short-textured-crop, deliberate accent: sculptural fringe. Wardrobe: layered-wrap, specifically overlapping wrap panels, an off-center waist tie, divided trousers, and soft boots; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette indigo-sand. Visible personal details: one bounded geometric forearm tattoo; a narrow bracelet stack; contrasting boot laces. Make a tattoo, scar, freckle field, or birthmark the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: visible mending treated as prideful craft. Color treatment: uses the palette boldly in large blocks. Pose cue: torso angles three-quarter while both arms hang in deliberate asymmetric ease. Include a small empty medicine pouch only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
